### The Ark of the Covenant
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/ark-covenant
Passage: Exodus 25:10-22
Points:
- The ark and mercy seat served as an earthly replica of the Lord's heavenly throne room.
- Placing the tablets of the Law inside the chest mirrored ancient royal customs of keeping laws at the king's feet.
- The mercy seat covered the Law, showing God's gracious intention to cover Israel's transgressions.
- The sacrificial blood sprinkled upon the mercy seat averted wrath and foreshadowed the cleansing blood of Jesus.
- Believers can now approach the presence of God in reverent worship through Christ's finished work.

### What Is the Mercy Seat?
Author: Stephen Nichols
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/articles/mercy-seat-connecting-dots
Passage: Exodus 25:22
Points:
- Exodus 25:22 identifies the mercy seat between the cherubim as the place where God meets His people.
- The Greek translation connects the mercy seat directly to propitiation, the sacrifice that satisfies divine wrath.
- The two angels situated at the head and feet of Jesus' empty tomb echo the cherubim at the ends of the mercy seat.
- The Old Testament mercy seat prefigured Jesus Christ, through whom God now meets and redeems believers.
